category.descriptionFallback: Shop {categoryName} at {siteName}, with delivery to Kosovo, Albania and North Macedonia.

sections.heading: 1. Who operates this store
body: Majestiqos is an independent online retailer and the operating business behind this website. Contact details are listed on the Contact page and in the site footer.

sections.heading: 2. Nature of the products and age restriction
body: Every product sold here is an accessory for heated-tobacco devices — cases, covers, chargers, cleaning tools, lanyards, and holders. This store does not sell tobacco, nicotine, or heated-tobacco devices themselves.

Because these accessories are intended for use with a tobacco product, they are restricted to buyers aged 18 and over. By placing an order, you confirm you are at least 18 years old. The courier may request proof of age on delivery, and delivery may be refused if age cannot be reasonably confirmed.

sections.heading: 3. How ordering works
body: Checkout requires only the information needed to fulfil your order — name, phone number, delivery address, and an optional email. Prices, discounts, and the order total are always calculated by our systems from the current, real price of each product; nothing entered by you as a price or total is ever trusted or used.
Once you submit an order, we contact you by phone to confirm the details before it is prepared for delivery.

sections.heading: 4. Payment
body: Payment is cash on delivery only. You pay the courier in cash when your order arrives. We do not collect card numbers, bank details, or any other payment information through this website.

sections.heading: 5. Prices
body: All prices are shown in euro (EUR), including any applicable taxes. The price shown on the product page and in your cart at the time you submit an order is the price you pay — a later change to a product's price does not affect an order already placed.

sections.heading: 6. Shipping
body: We currently deliver to Kosovo, Albania, and North Macedonia. Shipping cost is €2.00 to Kosovo and €5.00 to Albania, North Macedonia, and other destinations. Typical delivery takes 2–5 business days, depending on destination and courier availability. You will be contacted by phone before delivery.

sections.heading: 7. Cancellation and returns
body: You may cancel an order any time before it has shipped by contacting us using the details on the Contact page. Because payment is collected on delivery, you are also free to decline an order at the door if you no longer want it, at no cost to you.

Once an order has been accepted and paid for, returns are handled case by case — contact us within 14 days of delivery if a product arrives damaged, faulty, or materially different from what was ordered.

sections.heading: 8. Limitation of liability
body: We take reasonable care to describe products accurately and to fulfil orders as placed. To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential loss arising from your use of this website or your purchase of a product, beyond the value of the order itself. Nothing in these terms limits any liability that cannot be limited under applicable law.

sections.heading: 9. Trademark disclaimer
body: "IQOS" is a registered trademark of Philip Morris International. Majestiqos is an independent retailer of third-party accessories that are compatible with IQOS devices. We are not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Philip Morris International or any of its affiliates. Any reference to IQOS is solely to describe compatibility.

sections.heading: 1. What we collect
body: To fulfil an order, we collect your first and last name, phone number, delivery address (including city and country), and, if you choose to provide one, your email address. We also store the products and quantities in your order, and a brief note if you leave one for the courier.

sections.heading: 2. Why we collect it
body: We use this information for one purpose: to prepare, confirm by phone, and deliver your order. We do not use it for marketing unless you separately and explicitly agree to that in the future.

sections.heading: 3. Payment data
body: We do not collect any payment data. Payment is cash on delivery, collected by the courier — no card numbers, bank details, or similar information ever passes through this website or our systems.

sections.heading: 4. How long we keep it
body: Order records are kept for 24 months after the order date, after which the personal details on the order are anonymized while the underlying sales record is kept for accounting purposes. If you request earlier deletion, see "Your rights" below.

sections.heading: 5. Who we share it with
body: Your name, phone number, and delivery address are shared with the courier company delivering your order — that is the only third party your information is shared with. We do not sell your information to anyone, for any reason.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
body: You can ask us to tell you what information we hold about you, or to delete it, at any time — see the Contact page for how to reach us. We will act on a deletion request unless we are legally required to keep the underlying order record (for example, for accounting purposes), in which case we anonymize the personal details instead.

sections.heading: 7. Cookies
body: This website does not use marketing or analytics cookies. It uses one small, functional piece of stored data to remember your cart and your language preference (Albanian or English) between visits — nothing that identifies you personally, and nothing used to track you across other websites.

sections.heading: 8. Contact
body: For any question about this policy, or to exercise your rights above, contact us using the details on the Contact page.
